ai-workflows.title: AI Workflow Systems
ai-workflows.subtitle: Turn manual admin into intelligent workflows.
ai-workflows.heroDescription: From incoming request to closed task: extraction, checks, approval, action in the next system, with a full trace back. No brittle automation that breaks on the first exception.

example.title: In practice
example.body: A shared supplier inbox is parsed automatically, matched to the right purchase order, and only sent to the operations lead when there's doubt. The rest goes straight to the ERP.

kennissystemen.title: Private Knowledge Systems
kennissystemen.subtitle: Make company knowledge actually usable.
kennissystemen.heroDescription: Your most valuable knowledge shouldn't be trapped in folders, inboxes and senior employees' heads. We build private AI knowledge systems that give staff accurate answers, grounded in your own documents and respecting access rules.

example.title: In practice
example.body: A staff member asks about the correct procedure for an exception. The system shows the right policy article, cites the source page, and hides sections this role has no access to.

documentverwerking.title: AI Document & Data Processing
documentverwerking.subtitle: Turn unstructured documents into reliable data.
documentverwerking.heroDescription: Stop retyping data from PDFs and chasing incomplete documents. We build extraction pipelines that transform unstructured files into validated, usable data — while routing uncertainty to the right person.

example.title: In practice
example.body: Incoming invoices are extracted, checked against purchase orders, flagged on mismatch, and queued for approval in the existing accounting tool.

integraties.title: Business Systems Integration
integraties.subtitle: Connect the systems your business already runs on.
integraties.heroDescription: Your software should work as one system, not a collection of disconnected tools. We build the secure integration layer that moves data reliably across your business — with logs, retries and error handling you can read.

example.title: In practice
example.body: A webshop order creates an invoice in accounting, reduces stock in the ERP and opens a ticket in the service desk — with a weekly reconciliation report.

softwareontwikkeling.title: Custom Software Development
softwareontwikkeling.subtitle: The foundation the AI systems run on.
softwareontwikkeling.heroDescription: Before AI solves a problem, someone has to build the application that runs it. That's the core skill here. Web apps, internal tools and portals — written, deployed and maintained by the person you actually talk to.

example.title: In practice
example.body: A client portal where businesses log in, follow their status in real time and open tickets, wired into the team's internal workflow tools.
